The '''IL-5 Ocula''', also known to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as the '''IL-5 Skybolt''', was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. Czerka's first entry into the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] starfighter field, the craft was well-known for its proprietary miniaturization techniques that allowed for almost all popular internal components to be installed.<ref name="GS" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic War]], the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] chose to forgo purchasing the Ocula in favor of [[Corellia StarDrive]]'s designs, but a number of Oculas&mdash;redesignated the Skybolt&mdash;were utilized by regional [[Governor/Legends|governors]] and [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]]. The Ocula was also particularly popular with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], who ordered thousands of Oculas through intermediaries.<ref name="GS" />

During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], Navigator [[Uptin]] transported Republic forces from [[Keylander Station]] to the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] aboard a IL-5 shuttle.<ref name="TOR:TiP" /> During the same campaign, The Sith Empire used a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked]] IL-5 Ocula to transport Imperial operatives from the [[Makeb orbital station]] to the surface of Makeb.<ref name="TOR:TPtH">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|To Pierce the Heavens|Makeb orbital station}}</ref>

<div style="float: right">[[File:Mandalorian_Shuttle.png|thumb|right|250px|Shae Vizla's shuttle]]</div>
During the [[Third Galactic War]], [[Whisper (IL-5 Ocula)|one]] IL-5 Ocula was the personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] of [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]], better known as Mandalore the Avenger. It was used by Shae Vizla, [[Rass Ordo]] and the [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] to [[Showdown on Ruhnuk|travel]] to [[Ruhnuk]] during the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian Civil War]].<ref name="TOR:ARaaHP" /> Shae Vizla later used her shuttle to [[Malgus's escape|rescue]] [[Darth Malgus]] from [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR:Sundering">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sundering|Carrick Station}}</ref>
